steps.title: Discovery
body: Goals, audience and technical limits are written down.
We clarify whether you need web, panel, CRM or chatbot work.

steps.title: Scope
body: Page and feature list, priorities, success criteria.
No build starts without approved scope.

steps.title: Design
body: Interface, components and a CSS design system when needed.
If brand language is missing, identity comes before code.

steps.title: Development
body: Web on Next.js and React; panels, CRM and chatbots connect to the same system.
Mobile apps join the same plan when required.

steps.title: Audit
body: Speed, mobile, accessibility and technical SEO are checked.
Critical paths (quote, booking, contact) are tested.

steps.title: Launch
body: It goes live and we monitor it. Support days follow the package.
Further improvements open under a new scope when needed.

about.label: Agency
about.p1: METEK Digital is a web design and software agency based in Malatya. We build corporate websites, admin panels, CRM systems, CSS design systems, WhatsApp and Instagram chatbots, and mobile apps. The agency is led by Nurullah Aydın.
about.p2: If your brand language is ready, we work inside it. If not, we start with logo and identity, then build after approval.
about.p3: We do not sell bought themes. Each project is scoped to how the business sells and operates.
about.doIntro: No shelf packages. Website, panel, CRM, chatbot or mobile app is scoped to the real need.
